title: Representing a graph
summary: Adjacency lists, directed vs undirected edges, degrees.
hints: Start with `Graph g(n);`: that creates `n` empty neighbour lists, one per vertex. Then for each edge `(u, v)`, `g[u].push_back(v)`. An undirected edge also needs `g[v].push_back(u)`.
`out_degree` is just the size of one list: `g[u].size()`, converted to `int`. `has_edge` can loop over `g[u]` looking for `v`, or use `std::find`.
`in_degrees`: make a result vector of `g.size()` zeros, then walk every list of every vertex, and for each neighbour `v` found, do `++result[v]`.
